# Final Review Votes
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.5-xhigh

## Summary

One amendment was reviewed. It describes a real safety defect in metadata authentication for mixed low/high VSS recovery candidates.

## Votes

- `fr-2-5594977e`: Accept
  The code accepts a successful 24-word candidate when the low and high halves each meet threshold, but it only requires the intersection of shares verifying for both halves to be non-empty before deriving metadata. Since `derive_metadata` then takes a strict majority over that reduced complete-share set, a single complete share can become the whole metadata electorate. Authentication only checks the no-passphrase wallet identity, so an `is_duress` flip on that one share can survive authentication and later permit passphrase recovery. Requiring at least threshold distinct complete verified share identifiers, or rejecting/withholding metadata when that cannot be met, is technically justified.
